name: Fallen Hero of the Horde
summary: At the southern road from the Swamp of Sorrows, the Fallen Hero of the Horde keeps watch. Regret and dishonor bind him there. He warns travelers of the Blasted Lands and seeks champions to free his tortured soldiers from demonic bondage.

sections.title: A Tragic Command
sections.body:
In life, the orc warrior was a celebrated champion. He led a handpicked regiment sent to investigate the Blasted Lands and report on the Burning Legion. But his dispatch never arrived. The courier bound for Stonard was ambushed and slain by the Swamp Talker and his murlocs.

Without orders or reinforcements, the commander marched south into the shattered wastes to face the growing darkness. It was a fatal choice. Demonic forces overwhelmed his army, scattering and capturing his soldiers. Razelikh the Defiler then subjected them to horrific torment.

sections.title: The Price of Failure
sections.body:
The Fallen Hero of the Horde was captured with his lieutenant, Kirith, and tortured in the Serpent's Coil. Their captors tore the souls from his surviving men. He escaped, but fatal wounds claimed him near the swamp's border. His spirit remains tethered to the threshold of the Blasted Lands.

His soldiers met a darker fate. Their soulless husks were bound to mystic stones as immortal thralls. Razelikh and his lieutenants, Archmage Allistarj, Lady Sevine, and Grol the Destroyer, divided them among themselves. The soul-binding stones must be shattered and their torment ended before the restless spirit can know peace.

faq.q: Who was the Fallen Hero in life?
faq.answer: In life, he was a veteran orc warrior chosen to lead a reconnaissance force into the Blasted Lands and assess the demonic threat. He escaped torture at the hands of Razelikh the Defiler, but died of grievous wounds. His spirit remains by the road out of the Swamp of Sorrows.

faq.q: Why is he haunting the border of the Blasted Lands?
faq.answer: The shame of losing his regiment and failing his mission binds him to the border. He will not pass on until brave adventurers go south and destroy the stones of binding that hold his soldiers in eternal servitude to the Burning Legion.

faq.q: What happened to the orders he sent to Stonard?
faq.answer: The scout carrying his urgent report to Stonard was ambushed and killed by murlocs led by the Swamp Talker. With the report lost, no reinforcements came, and the hero advanced alone into the Blasted Lands.

faq.q: What happened to his lieutenant, Kirith?
faq.answer: Lieutenant Kirith endured demonic experiments within the Serpent's Coil. His soul was warped, and his body became a monstrous felhunter lurking in the cave's depths.

Razelikh and his lieutenants severed the captive soldiers' souls from their flesh. Their soulless bodies cannot truly die. They can be freed only by battering the bodies near disintegration, which briefly leaves the nearby soul-binding stones vulnerable to destruction.

angles.text: The hero shows the agony of a warrior whose honor demonic cruelty stripped away. As a Horde adventurer, you can avenge his lost squad and cleanse the stain of defeat from their legacy.
As a warrior, you may feel kinship with this fallen champion and understand the sting of surviving when comrades have fallen.
